term: conditional existential support for a correct named goodness account
definition: If a correct admissible account exists, some admissible correct account has the extension of one of the supplied named due/feature/approval accounts. The witness may differ from the original existential witness. This sufficient bridge neither asserts existence nor classifies every admissible or every correct proposal. Global SemanticNamedCoverage is stronger, as a populated wrong-unnamed-account control verifies.
note: Analyst sufficient support; attribution deferred. Uses exactly the original GoodnessFormEnd meanings. Property identity remains separate from coextension; no globally weakest formulation or adopted coverage. See docs/notes/truth-definition-use-audit.md.
